blocks.text: Gun powder 75% potassium nitrate (KNO₃), 15% lakri ke koyle (wood charcoal) aur 10% sulfur ka mota (coarse) mixture hai. Koyle ka carbon asal fuel hai, nitrate oxidiser (oxygen dene wala) hai, aur sulfur extra fuel hai jo powder ko tez jalata hai. Jalne par yeh reaction hota hai:

blocks.prompt: Gun powder band jagah mein kyun phat-ta hai?
blocks.explanation: Nitrate apni oxygen khud deta hai, is liye jalne ke liye hawa ki zaroorat nahi aur reaction bohat tez hota hai. Solid (thos) cheezon se garam gas ke 11 moles (6CO₂ + 5N₂) ban jate hain, jo band jagah mein zor se phailte hain.

blocks.prompt: a) Khane ko preserve (mehfooz) karne mein SO₂ aur sulfite (SO₃²⁻) salts ka kya kaam hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh reducing agents aur antimicrobial (jaraseem maarne wale) hain: khushk phal, juices waghera ko oxidation se brown hone aur rang badalne se bachate hain, aur bacteria, yeast aur mould (phaphoondi) ki growth rokte hain. Is liye khana zyada der tak theek rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) S ka HCl aur NaOH se reaction batayein.
blocks.explanation: Sulfur dilute non-oxidising acid HCl se react nahi karta (12.10). Garam concentrated NaOH mein sulfur disproportionate hota hai (ek hi waqt mein oxidise aur reduce), sulfide aur thiosulfate bante hain: 4S + 6NaOH → 2Na₂S + Na₂S₂O₃ + 3H₂O.

items: Gun powder: 75% KNO₃ (oxidiser), 15% koyla (fuel), 10% S (extra fuel).
